$comment: This is the machine-readable version of brand/business.md.
A human fills in business.md; the AI agent keeps this file in sync with it.
Every colour and font here becomes a CSS variable that all boards share, so
changing a colour here restyles every menu and flyer at once.
Everything below is EXAMPLE DATA for a fictional business. Replace it.

voice.tone: Warm, plainspoken, a little proud. Never salesy, never cute.

fonts.$comment: google: the query part of a Google Fonts URL. Leave empty and set `url` or `local` for anything else.

legal.allergen: Items may contain nuts, dairy, gluten or shellfish. Tell your server about any allergy.
legal.disclaimer: Prices subject to change. Specials not valid on holidays.

print.$comment: Ask your print shop for these numbers once, then never think about them again.
print.notes: Supply PDFs. Printer converts to CMYK in-house.
